definition: to hold something down so it cannot move
description: On a windy sandy beach under a blue sky with white clouds, a young woman in a white linen shirt kneels on all fours on a red and white striped beach shelter and holds it down with her hands and knees, laughing. The wind lifts the shelter higher and higher, and she ends up lying flat on it. Loose metal tent pegs lie in the sand in front of her. Behind her a young man and woman in swimwear run and chase a flying yellow towel and a straw hat near the turquoise sea.

taps.phrase: to reach for the flying towel
